#YourCareer starts with doing what you like 😊

We are always looking for talented and motivated colleagues to join our team and together, contribute to the creation of a sustainable future, based on inclusion, empathy, respect and equal opportunities.

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to contribute to automating our infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and application deployments. You will work alongside senior team members, applying your knowledge of DevOps tools to help build and maintain a robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure that supports our development teams.

Responsibilities:

  • AWS Infrastructure Management: Experience with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) on AWS. Deploy and manage AWS resources independently, applying performance, security, and cost optimization best practices. Collaborate with senior engineers on complex architectural decisions.

  • GitLab Administration: Manage GitLab operations, including configuration and maintenance. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, following established standards.

  • Containerization and Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Docker and containerization technologies. Manage Kubernetes workloads and support EKS cluster operations, including deployments, troubleshooting, and scaling.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform to provision and manage resources efficiently, following established patterns and standards.

  • Configuration Management: Use Ansible to automate deployment processes and manage configuration across environments.

  • Scripting and Automation: Develop scripts in Python and Bash for automation and integration tasks.

  • Networking: Manage basic networking components including VPCs, subnets, security groups, and load balancers.

  • Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain monitoring and alerting using Prometheus. Create and maintain dashboards in Grafana. Implement and manage log aggregation with Loki

  • Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and operation of systems.

  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve infrastructure and application issues, escalating complex or unfamiliar problems when appropriate.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay current with DevOps trends, tools, and best practices.

Skills and Experience:

  • 2–4 years of experience in DevOps or related roles

  • Experience with AWS services and cloud computing concepts

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals

  • Experience in GitLab, Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Bash

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code principles

  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Strong communication and willingness to collaborate

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to GitOps practices (ArgoCD, Flux)

  • Basic security practices (IAM policies, least privilege, secrets handling)

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow

What’s in it for you:

✔️ Professional growth/ Development

  • dynamic work environment and different business lines

  • international work environment

  • internal mobility programs

  • courses, coaching sessions, mentoring

  • reimbursement of part of the holiday ticket 

  • extra free days (Birthday, Energetician's Day, etc.)

  • special offers from our collaborators

  • referral employee program

  • short Friday

What else do you need to know?

Confidentiality of the recruitment process

At PPC, we respect the confidentiality of each application. Only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview, and other applications will be kept in our database for one year maximum.

About PPC

We are leaders in energy in South-Eastern Europe, active in the production, distribution and supply of electricity, as well as developing innovative solutions for a sustainable future. With an installed capacity of 10.7 GW, we provide energy for 8.7 million clients and deliver over 35 TWh annually.

In Romania, PPC became a top player with the acquisition of Enel companies in October 2023. With a history that began in 1950, we are listed on the Athens Stock Exchange and are constantly expanding our vision.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

I believe that energy comes from people. At PPC, every voice counts, and diversity is the engine of our innovation. Regardless of age, ethnicity, gender or disability, it offers an inclusive environment where you can grow and perform.

🔹 #EnergyForAll – for your career, for the future, for everyone
